preregistration: this file, committed before any generation (record-first). Owner answers 18-Oct-2026, in-session: measure control-narratives (README: 'unmeasured (no baseline yet)'); cap $30; models Opus 5.5 + Sonnet 5.5; tasks blind-authored only (ADR 0101 decision 1).
hypothesis: Neutral (ADR 0059): for each model, appending the control-narratives skill body to the system prompt may raise, lower, or leave unchanged the graded fraction of expectations met, versus the same model with no skill, on Claude Opus 5.5 and on Claude Sonnet 5.5. A null, a harmful result, or a model-dependent result are equally valid recorded outcomes.

scope.why: first measurement of the skill; no prior baseline exists

arms.without: claude -p --model <M> --effort medium, isolation flags (--tools "", --disable-slash-commands, --strict-mcp-config, shared deny list), empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, cwd outside the checkout; hermetic_driver.NEUTRAL_FRAME + task text on stdin; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=32000
arms.with: without + --append-system-prompt = treatments/control-narratives.txt (live SKILL.md body at source_sha, frontmatter stripped)

isolation_probe: 18-Oct, before pre-registration: a bare Sonnet 5.5 call under the without-arm flags reported no skills or plugins, no text mentioning ISA-106, ASD-STE100 or control narratives, and no memory or CLAUDE.md content. This matters because the account carries a synced copy of control-narratives. Two probe calls, about $0.015, outside the cap accounting below.
effort: medium for both models, as the 12-Oct batches
instrument: scripts copied from 2026-10-12-g8-shortfall at its committed state; changes are scope only (one skill, NEW_FROM_ID=1 so every eval is prescreened, no inherited selection, provenance split collapsed to one blind group, lib path skill-measure after the ADR 0097 rename; the lib is byte-identical to skill-bench's). Comparable in protocol to the 12-Oct verdicts; not a trend comparison across skills.

evals.authorship: 16 tasks (ids 1-16), authored by a fresh lane told to read no file on disk and use no web search, given only the skill's one-line public description, told to write outcome expectations, never vocabulary, headings, standard names or structure unless the task demands them. Added verbatim, unedited.

prescreen.rule: 1 bare rep per eval per model, graded before any with-arm cell. Bare fraction-met >= 0.85 = saturated -> dropped for that model only; an eval whose prescreen cell errored is kept (unscreened). Prescreen cells are never reused in the grid.
prescreen.g_floor: a model with fewer than 8 surviving evals still runs, labelled DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY: it may mark the claim UNDERPOWERED, never back a KEEP (ADR 0095 decision 4)

pilot.rule: 2 with-arm cells per model on eval 1; per-model per-cell cost = mean of pilot and prescreen generation + judge per call (ADR 0073)

grid: surviving evals x {with, without} x 2 models x 2 reps
judging: Claude Opus 5.5 judge, isolated identically, rubric.skill_grade_prompt per cell. Same family as the generators: every verdict here is FRAME-UNCHECKED (ADR 0093) and may not be promoted to a README KEEP until a cross-family judge grades the same committed cells (`grade.py --judges grok`) and agrees. No cross-family CLI is installed in this container.
metrics: per model: eval-clustered mean of (with - without) fraction-met, mean over reps within eval; benchstats.keep_verdict (KEEP iff 95% t-interval lower bound > 0, HARMFUL iff upper < 0, else INCONCLUSIVE; practical bar 0) plus mde80. Primary: the 2 per-model verdicts.
power: at the repo's measured spread 0.24, G=8 reliably calls about 0.30 and G=10 about 0.25 (pre-registration.md sizing table); a smaller true effect will likely read INCONCLUSIVE.
secondary: pooled blind delta over both models' (model, eval) clusters (ADR 0101 split, one group here); per-eval deltas and win rates.
multiplicity: 2 primary intervals at 95% each, no correction: about 0.1 false KEEP/HARMFUL calls expected under a global null.

cost.prior_estimate: about $10-15 all-in at 12-Oct per-cell costs (opus 0.094, sonnet 0.058 incl. judge)
cost.spent_breakdown: generation $11.15 (prescreen 3.22, pilot 1.41, grid 6.52) + Opus judge $6.35 (prescreen 2.20, grid 4.15)
